stop.prompt: If this turn changed behavior in src/, themes/, lang/, routes, or ACL catalogs, confirm (1) matching files under docs/ were updated (start at docs/map.md + docs/patterns.md), (2) a unit test under tests/Unit/ was added or adjusted when production behavior changed (docs/testing.md), (3) new admin mutations call requireAdminResource / runMassActions / requireAdminSection. If already current, do not make extra edits — one-line status and stop.
